turns.user: my shoulder hurts when I press
turns.reply:
Sorry to hear that, Ashley. Since we want to make sure we're not pushing through anything that could make it worse, let's figure out what we're dealing with. 

What does the pain actually feel like when you press — is it a sharp pinch, or more of a dull, deep ache? And does it happen only at a certain point in the movement, or the whole time?

turns.user: it's sharp, right at the front, and only on the right side. been about a week
turns.reply:
Thanks for the detail, Ashley. Since that pain is sharp, on one side, and has been lingering for a week, it's really important that we don't try to work through it or guess at a fix. 

That kind of sharp, one-sided joint pain is outside what I can safely coach you on. I highly recommend having a physio or doctor take a look at it so you can get a proper assessment. 

For today, let's absolutely skip any pressing that triggers it so we don't aggravate things. How does the rest of your upper body feel, and would you like to focus on some lower body or core work instead today?
